photos.published.statement: SELECT id, file_id, title, caption, published_at FROM photos WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 60

feed.items.statement: SELECT id, title, caption, '/_littlebox/files/' || file_id AS image, published_at FROM photos WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20

studio.photos.statement: SELECT id, file_id, title, caption, status, created_at, published_at FROM photos WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM studio WHERE user_id = ?1) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 200

studio.messages.statement: SELECT id, name, email, topic, body, received_at FROM messages WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM studio WHERE user_id = ?1) ORDER BY received_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100

photos.add.statement: INSERT INTO photos (file_id, title, caption, status, created_at, published_at) SELECT ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, CASE WHEN ?5 = 'published' THEN ?6 END WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM studio WHERE user_id = ?1)

photos.publish.statement: UPDATE photos SET status = 'published', file_id = ?3, published_at = ?4 WHERE id = ?2 AND status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM studio WHERE user_id = ?1)

contact.send.statement: INSERT INTO messages (name, email, topic, body, received_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)
